note: Written-reason registry for enforcement invariant (3) of scripts/feature-matrix-tiers.py (issue #5138): a cargo feature that a fragment-carrying crate DECLARES but that appears in NO leg of that crate, is activated by no executor the guard models (ci.yml's workspace default lane, a test:true feature-matrix leg, or a scripts/coverage.sh case arm), and that the detector classifies SENSITIVE. Every entry needs a NON-EMPTY written reason and is one of exactly two kinds, and the reason MUST say which: (A) COVERED-ELSEWHERE — a real executor the guard cannot model (e.g. a dedicated ci.yml job), so the entry is permanent until that executor moves; (B) RECORDED GAP — no known executor; the entry is DEBT, seeded so invariant (3) can gate NEW occurrences while the pre-existing set is triaged per-crate. A kind-(B) entry is not a justification and must not be read as one. This file is held STRICT in both directions: --enforce also REDs on a STALE entry (feature no longer declared, now legged, now executed, or now non-sensitive), so the list can only shrink. Do NOT add an entry to silence a NEW gated test — add the executor instead. See also scripts/check-feature-test-execution.allowlist.json, the sibling registry for the C1 guard (unmapped feature-gated TEST TARGETS); several reasons below cite it because the two guards see the same gap from different angles.
